title: Beitou Hot Spring Museum
scope: The restored 1913 Beitou public bathhouse, including the timber upper entrance and galleries, lower red-brick bath wing, intersecting tiled roofs and chimneys.
limitations: The road entrance, roof intersections and brick downhill wing follow the map, verified photographs and city facts. Unpublished sections, lesser roofs and some windows are approximate.
The model covers the exterior bathhouse and attached entrance shelter. Pool interiors, heritage exhibits and neighboring park structures are outside the model scope.
